description: Single, wages and interest: flat 3% after the 2026 standard deduction
working: IT-540 line 7 federal AGI = 60,000 + 1,500 = 61,500. Line 8 standard deduction (single, 2026 indexed) = 12,875. Line 10 = 61,500 - 12,875 = 48,625. Line 11 = 48,625 x 3% = 1,458.75 (the form rounds to 1,459). No exemptions or credits apply.

description: Joint filers with two children, dividends and long-term gains: no dependent exemptions and gains taxed in full at 3%
working: Federal AGI = 120,000 + 4,000 + 10,000 = 134,000. Louisiana repealed dependent exemptions and the net capital gain deduction (Act 11 of 2024), so the children and gains change nothing. Standard deduction (MFJ, 2026 indexed) = 25,750. Taxable = 134,000 - 25,750 = 108,250. Tax = 108,250 x 3% = 3,247.50.
